name: Emeria
description: Emeria is a Zendikar name for both a floating kor ruin, the Emeria Skyclave, and the angel figure Jace meets in his mind.

summary.text: Emeria is a Zendikar name for both a floating kor ruin, the Emeria Skyclave, and the angel figure Jace meets in his mind.

bio.text: Jace met a hooded angel he recognized as Emeria from Zendikar statues and wondered whether she was Emrakul.
She offered him a chess game for answers, and he realized the angel was his mind's personification of Emrakul and checkmated her.
Compleated Nahiri decided to use the Emeria Skyclave to connect the hedron networks.
She fused herself into the Skyclave's heart as its keystone.
The keystone broke and the Skyclave fell with her trapped inside.
Afterward Nahiri, awake and without her spark, tore Phyrexian metal from the Skyclave and climbed out through its roof into sunlight.

status.text: As of the latest story, the Skyclave lies crashed, and Nahiri has torn a stairway through its roof and climbed out into sunlight.

timeline.summary: Flashback: As children, Kiora and Turi listen to Elder Misha's Cosi story about Cosi swapping Ula's spear for a feather.
timeline.quote: Cosi snuck to Ula's bedside at the bottom of the sea and swapped his great spear for a gull's feather

timeline.summary: The army descends from the hedrons of Emeria, and Gideon leads its first march on Sea Gate with a shout of "For Zendikar!"
timeline.quote: He shouted, "For Zendikar!" and a deafening roar came in answer.

timeline.summary: Through a door at the stairway's end Jace meets an angel he recognizes as Emeria from Zendikar statues and wonders whether she is Emrakul.
timeline.quote: I know this angel.

timeline.summary: Emeria offers Jace a game of chess: if he wins, all stops and she will give him answers.
timeline.quote: If you win, this all stops. I will give you all the answers you want.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the angel is his mind's personification of Emrakul and checkmates her.
timeline.quote: He put his hand on his queen, moved it into position.

timeline.summary: Jace's chess pieces mutate and kill each other, and the angel says they were always her pieces and she no longer wants to play.
timeline.quote: They are all my pieces, Jace Beleren.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, compleated and with blades for hands, surveys the Phyrexian invasion from a floating stone and decides to use the Emeria Skyclave to connect the hedron networks.
timeline.quote: the Skyclave in Emeria will be the perfect access point to connect the entire hedron networks

timeline.summary: Akiri's party searches for Nahiri following Tazri's vision, and Akiri spots the changed Nahiri on an isolated fragment.
timeline.quote: She has changed, but even from a distance, Akiri knows who it is.

timeline.summary: Akiri tracks Nahiri, watching the Skyclave turn to white metal and more invaders arrive.
timeline.quote: She's witnessed the Skyclave's broken stone mend and transform into white metal.

timeline.summary: Linvala brings Tazri to Akiri's party, and they agree they are the only ones left to stop Nahiri.
timeline.quote: "We are the only ones left to stop Nahiri,"

timeline.summary: The party enters the Skyclave through a small uncorrupted entrance, resolved to stop Nahiri.
timeline.quote: "We did not defeat the Eldrazi to be destroyed by this,"

timeline.summary: The party kills a corrupted tree elemental, and Orah's fingers are covered in black oil.
timeline.quote: The tips of his fingers are covered in a sickly black oil.

timeline.summary: Surrounded by Phyrexianized elementals, the party is saved when Linvala's light parts the elementals and reveals a door.
timeline.quote: Tazri looks and sees Linvala radiating with light and charging forward.

timeline.summary: They barricade the door and find the carcasses of the Skyclave's creatures.
timeline.quote: Around them are the carcasses of every living creature that didn't survive the Phyrexian transformation.

timeline.summary: In flashback, Nahiri recounts converting or killing the elementals and pouring her joy, anger and grief into the hedron network until nothing is left.
timeline.quote: So, she channeled her pain, her grief from the betrayals, the losses, the loneliness over the millennia.

timeline.summary: Nahiri fuses herself into the Skyclave's heart as its keystone, pouring in her essence.
timeline.quote: becoming its keystone, the heart that binds her work here together.

timeline.summary: The party confronts Nahiri, who recognizes Akiri and smashes her thrown knife with stone.
timeline.quote: "Tiny elementals. Cute," Nahiri says

timeline.summary: Nahiri's stone attacks beat back Tazri and her friends, and it seems Zendikar is lost.
timeline.quote: Zendikar is lost.

timeline.summary: Linvala's radiance and Tazri's halo burn away oil and stun Phyrexia's power; Tazri hurls the halo at Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Tazri yanks the halo off from around her neck and in one desperate movement, hurls it at the entombed Planeswalker.

timeline.summary: The keystone breaks and Nahiri crumbles out of the stone; the Skyclave begins to collapse.
timeline.quote: the keystone breaks and Nahiri crumbles from her stone and metal embrace.

timeline.summary: Akiri leads her friends out of the collapsing Skyclave, leaping into the sky and catching a hedron with her rope.
timeline.quote: But Akiri is a master line-slinger and midway through their failing arc, she lets her rope fly.

timeline.summary: The Skyclave falls with the corrupted Planeswalker trapped inside, while the sky takes on a soft iridescent glow.
timeline.quote: The Emeria Skyclave is falling to the earth.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, now without her spark and awake after the invasion, tears Phyrexian metal from her own body and then from the Skyclave, piling it in a cairn.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Nahiri ripped the taint of Phyrexia from her plane.

timeline.summary: Nahiri recalls a blast of Halo and realizes she is alive but hollow, no longer a Planeswalker.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: The core of her power, her spark, no longer a part of her.

timeline.summary: A metal claw nearly stabs her and Phyrexian memories surge before she rejects them.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: That was the ghost of Phyrexia. It was not her.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reaches the chamber where she fused herself into the Skyclave and finds a hidden hedron containing her spark inside the wall.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: It was her Planeswalker spark.

timeline.summary: Filled with hope, Nahiri tears a stairway through the Skyclave's roof and climbs out into sunlight.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Sunlight dripped into the darkness.

timeline.summary: Ajani appears, restored and still a planeswalker, saying he came looking for her and reporting the deaths and survivors among the former evangels.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "Hello, Nahiri," Ajani said.

timeline.summary: Ajani proposes that he and Nahiri work together to make amends for what they did, and she refuses.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "Someone needs to make amends for what we've done.

timeline.summary: Nahiri suspects Ajani has come to kill her as one of the former evangels.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: What if he was here to kill her?

timeline.summary: Nahiri accuses Ajani of slaughtering Theros's gods and murdering Jaya Ballard; he snarls in grief.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: You slaughtered the gods of Theros. You murdered Jaya Ballard.

timeline.summary: Nahiri flings stone to make a wall and the Skyclave dome collapses under her, dropping her onto her cairn.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: and then the dome of the Skyclave collapsed beneath her feet.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds the hedron cracked and her spark gone, her last hope of regaining her power destroyed.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Her last hope at regaining her power—at becoming a Planeswalker once more—was gone.

relations.note: Jace concludes the angel is his mind's personification of Emrakul's emanations.
relations.quote: This was his mind's attempt to make sense of whatever pressures or emanations he was feeling from Emrakul.

pages_say.description: A false god of Zendikar, proved monstrous and deceitful.
A god of Zendikar's merfolk of the sky realm, since unmasked as the Eldrazi titan Emrakul.
The floating hedrons high above Tazeem where Gideon's army encamped.

A tall hooded angel with two swords and writhing ribbons whom Jace knows from statues on Zendikar; in his mind she plays chess with him and speaks for Emrakul, though he concludes it is only his mind personifying Emrakul.
The region of floating hedron shards in the sky.
A kor ruin among floating fragments that Nahiri converts into the heart of her hedron network.
The crashed kor ruin where Nahiri was fused into the walls, now her dark workspace.
